methodology.name: Exploratory Analog Similarity Index
methodology.prior_status: Illustrative scenario priors; not measured or calibrated site properties.
methodology.interpretation: Weighted scenario similarity, not a validated probability, mission readiness score or NASA endorsement.
methodology.climate_limitations: POWER grid-cell 2 m air climate does not resolve caves, summit relief or extraterrestrial surface thermal cycles. Fallback values are illustrative estimates, not observations.
methodology.geography: Representative WGS84 points and approximate elevations; Galapagos combines Santa Cruz/Isabela but samples only Santa Cruz.
methodology.formula: overall_asi = sum(target_weight[d] * dimension_score[d]); details in engine/README.md

shackleton-crater.name: Shackleton Crater / Lunar South Pole (Artemis)
shackleton-crater.context: Cold-trap interior scenario; does not represent the illuminated rim. Ice relevance is a hypothesis, not a local abundance measurement.

mare-tranquillitatis.name: Mare Tranquillitatis / Lunar Lava Tubes
mare-tranquillitatis.context: Shaded pit / hypothetical connected cave scenario; 17 C is modeled pit shade, not lunar surface climate or a proven habitable cave.

jezero-crater.name: Jezero Crater / Mars Delta and Basalt
jezero-crater.context: Present dry surface thermal scenario combined with ancient aqueous geology; not a reconstruction of ancient climate.

olympus-mons-flank.name: Olympus Mons Flank / Mars Volcanic Lava Tubes
olympus-mons-flank.context: Exposed volcanic flank thermal scenario with tube exploration relevance; no measured subsurface temperature assumed.

analogy_breakdowns.atmosphere_vacuum: Earth air does not reproduce lunar vacuum.
analogy_breakdowns.radiation: Earth atmosphere and magnetic shielding do not reproduce extraterrestrial ionizing radiation; POWER parameters here do not measure UV or radiation dose.
